title: Ultraviolet laser pulses engineer diamond defects selectively, leaving quantum qubits intact
title_zh: 紫外激光脉冲选择性地设计金刚石缺陷，使量子比特完好无损
summary: 当我们想到钻石时，我们通常会想到一种其价值源于其完美的材料。然而，在我的研究中，我对几乎相反的东西感兴趣：钻石内部的微小缺陷。这些原子级缺陷可以赋予钻石新的光学和电子特性，其中一些可以用作量子系统。挑战在于学习如何控制这些缺陷而不干扰其他缺陷。
abstract: When we think about a diamond, we often think about a material whose value comes from its perfection. In my research, however, I am interested in something almost opposite: the tiny imperfections inside diamonds. These atomic-scale defects can give diamonds new optical and electronic properties, and some of them can serve as quantum systems. The challenge is learning how to control these defects without disturbing the others.
